stackingCandidate.sameEffect: owner+effect family cooldown; target-specific shield replacement only when stronger
stackingCandidate.crossEffectDamage: additive same-event damage bonus cap 20%; no recursive secondary triggers
stackingCandidate.crossEffectMitigation: strongest eligible temporary equipment reduction, max 15%; true damage excluded
stackingCandidate.crossEffectShield: strongest active equipment-origin shield on target, no additive stacking; class shields separate pending approval
stackingCandidate.permanent: sum by canonical channel then apply cap once
stackingCandidate.chargeRule: one charge, expires, trigger cannot consume its own charge; one charge across Bellwake damage/heal branches
